newsitem.title: FRANCE: PSA falls after broker cuts forecast.
newsitem.headline: PSA falls after broker cuts forecast.

text.p: Shares in French carmaker PSA Peugeot Citroen fell against the trend on Monday after investment firm J.P. Morgan cut earnings estimates for the group, brokers said.
PSA shares were down 1.3 percent at 537 francs at 1535 GMT, while the CAC index was up 1.3 percent.
Morgan cut its net profit forecast for the group to 1.13 billion francs for 1997 from 1.51 billion previously and said it saw no let-up in the fierce, European car price war.
Another trader said the stock may have been hit by investors switching to Renault, which was up four percent.

Renault shares, which have languished for months near all time lows, were helped on Monday by chairman Louis Schweitzer's remarks in a newspaper interview that he hoped for a break-even this year in the car division.
The stock has also been helped by reports describing the huge popularity of the new Megane Scenic model.
